title: 926. Minimum Area Rectangle

examples.explanation: The outer four points form a 2 by 2 square.
Columns 3 and 4 with rows 1 and 3 give area 2.
No four points align into a rectangle.

hints: A pair of points can be a diagonal only when both x and y differ.
The other two corners (x1,y2) and (x2,y1) must both exist; a hash set makes this O(1).
Track the minimum width-times-height; 1 is the smallest possible positive area.
